reason: PURE. I noticed the pocket-sized sachets and the QR batch report first. I fly every few weeks, so a pre-portioned packet that fits in a toiletry bag beats a bottle, and bisglycinate is the form I want for sleep. I would try one box, not subscribe yet.
objection: Individual foil packets are wasteful, and it is a brand with zero reviews. I would not set up auto-ship before I have seen it work.
would_change_my_mind: A bottle option at a lower price per serving, or a batch of real verified reviews.
